articles.title: VIDEO: Massachusetts Governor Asks U.S. Navy for Help Recovering Bodies, Recorder from Sunken Lily Jean
articles.summary: Massachusetts officials have requested the United States Navy's assistance in retrieving equipment from the site where a fishing vessel sank in January. The tragic incident resulted in the loss of all seven crew members. The appeal highlights the Navy's specialized capabilities being sought for complex recovery operations following maritime disasters within national waters.

articles.title: Trump warns Iran ‘clock is ticking’; UAE reports drone strike at nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Officials in Abu Dhabi reported a drone strike caused a fire at a nuclear power plant in the United Arab Emirates on Sunday. This incident occurred amidst broader regional tensions, including stalled U.S.-Israel peace efforts, raising concerns about stability. The strike underscores the growing threat to critical infrastructure in volatile regions.

articles.title: UAE slams 'dangerous escalation' after drone hits near nuclear plant
articles.summary: The UAE's defence ministry is investigating a drone attack targeting a generator outside the Barakah nuclear power plant in Abu Dhabi. This incident highlights the growing threat of drone warfare and the vulnerability of critical national infrastructure. While the ministry confirmed it successfully managed the situation, identifying the attack's source is crucial for bolstering regional security and preventing future incidents.

articles.title: The Vampire Lestat Spotlights Anderson's Louis in New Key Art Poster
articles.summary: AMC's "Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat" has unveiled a new character profile poster, placing Jacob Anderson's Louis de Pointe du Lac at the forefront. This promotional material highlights Louis's significance in the upcoming series, based on Anne Rice's acclaimed novels. The focus on Anderson's portrayal aims to build anticipation for the gothic drama, promising a detailed exploration of the beloved character on television.

articles.title: hipengine 0.1.0
articles.summary: hipEngine is an ROCm-native local LLM inference engine purpose-built for AMD RDNA GPUs, specifically gfx1100 and gfx1151 series. It utilizes a compact Python host alongside a complete suite of tools to enable efficient, on-device processing of large language models. This development signifies advancements in leveraging AMD hardware for AI computations, facilitating local AI capabilities without relying on cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Four killed in Ukrainian drone attack on Russia
articles.summary: Ukraine launched a massive drone attack involving nearly 600 UAVs across Russian regions, including Moscow and Belgorod. This large-scale assault resulted in four civilian deaths, with Russian air defences reportedly intercepting 556 drones. The incident underscores the escalating intensity of drone warfare and its significant impact on civilian areas in the ongoing conflict.
